name: SIGMA  WAR  NOTES
description:
About This Game

Fantasy World Paradise

Originating from a fantasy future world amusement park, engage in battles with monsters within the park.



Conquest and Exploration

In a semi open map, conquer giant monsters, claim rewards, and obtain rare equipment.

You can also increase character strength by collecting monster cards and hidden items in the map.

Feeling delighted when exploring new discoveries, and feeling a strong sense of achievement when conquering monsters.



Simple operation and refreshing sense of impact

With simple operations, you can experience a good sense of impact
short_desc: This is an ACT action game that can achieve a satisfying sense of impact through simple operations.
